references.text: Complementary parts of Noah's account: 6:13 justifies the judgment on 'all flesh', while 9:17 establishes the covenant that secures 'all flesh' against future total destruction.
Theological parallel regarding the nature of covenants: Both show that God's covenants are made and confirmed through His specific words which are to be written down.
Principled parallel regarding the signs of covenants: The rainbow (9:17) and blood (Heb 9:20) both function as God's visible confirmation of a covenant that has been made.
Clear theological parallel: Both verses define a physical sign (the rainbow/circumcision) as the central proof of a covenant that has been made.
